nary_nodes.label: Washington wildfires force evacuations
evidence: Wildfires have forced around 60,000 people to evacuate parts of the north-western US state of Washington

nary_nodes.label: Three major blazes burn around Spokane
evidence: Three major blazes continued to burn around the city of Spokane on Monday
Three major blazes continued to burn around the city of Spokane on Monday, with officials warning the fires had not been contained.

nary_nodes.label: Governor declares statewide emergency
evidence: Washington State Governor Bob Ferguson has declared a statewide emergency
Washington State Governor Bob Ferguson has declared a statewide emergency and requested federal assistance after speaking with US President Donald Trump.

nary_nodes.label: Statewide ban on outdoor fires
evidence: On Monday, Gov Ferguson issued a statewide ban on all outdoor fires.

nary_nodes.label: Firefighters battle blazes
evidence: More than 900 firefighters are currently assigned to the blazes in Washington
More than 900 firefighters are currently assigned to the blazes in Washington, with more reinforcements expected to arrive from other states in the coming days.

nary_nodes.label: 60,000 people evacuated
evidence: Wildfires have forced around 60,000 people to evacuate parts of the north-western US state of Washington

nary_nodes.label: 700 buildings destroyed
evidence: The fires have destroyed around 700 buildings
The fires have destroyed around 700 buildings, including homes, businesses and other buildings.

nary_nodes.label: 10,000 customers without power
evidence: More than 10,000 electricity customers were left without power on Sunday
More than 10,000 electricity customers were left without power on Sunday, according to Avista Utilities.

nary_nodes.label: Half of customers restored
evidence: By Monday, around half of them had their power restored.

nary_nodes.label: 16 large uncontained wildfires
evidence: a total number of 16 large, uncontained wildfires on the landscape in Washington state
The fires in Spokane are among a total number of 16 large, uncontained wildfires on the landscape in Washington state as of Monday morning, according to the state's department of natural resources.

nary_nodes.label: 900 firefighters assigned
evidence: More than 900 firefighters are currently assigned to the blazes
More than 900 firefighters are currently assigned to the blazes in Washington, with more reinforcements expected to arrive from other states in the coming days.

nary_nodes.label: 26 drone disruptions
evidence: Drones disrupted operations 26 times on Sunday.

nary_nodes.label: 14 people to contact
evidence: officials were trying to contact 14 people
Spokane County Sheriff John Nowels said that officials were trying to contact 14 people to confirm they managed to safely evacuate.

nary_nodes.label: Mayor Brown calls it worst natural disaster
evidence: Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown described the situation to the BBC as "the worst natural disaster our region has faced"

nary_nodes.label: Official says area looks like war zone
evidence: one official said the burned area looks like a "war zone".
At a news conference on Monday, one official said the burned area looks like a "war zone".

nary_nodes.label: General Welsh compares to Iraq
evidence: Maj Gen Gent Welsh ... said the scene reminded him of his time serving in the US military in Iraq.
Maj Gen Gent Welsh, who commands the state's National Guard, said the scene reminded him of his time serving in the US military in Iraq.

nary_nodes.label: Sheriff Nowels says trying to contact 14
evidence: Spokane County Sheriff John Nowels said that officials were trying to contact 14 people
Spokane County Sheriff John Nowels said that officials were trying to contact 14 people to confirm they managed to safely evacuate.

nary_nodes.label: Mayor Brown urges vigilance
evidence: Mayor Brown said: "The most important thing is that people need to remain vigilant and be patient and comply when we ask them to be ready to evacuate or when we say it's time to evacuate."

Speaking to the BBC, Mayor Brown said: "The most important thing is that people need to remain vigilant and be patient and comply when we ask them to be ready to evacuate or when we say it's time to evacuate."

nary_nodes.label: Upthegrove urges no sparks
evidence: Commissioner of Public Lands Dave Upthegrove in a written statement: "Our firefighters are already stretched thin across the state, and with more heat and wind expected this weekend and for the rest of the summer, any new spark on our tinder dry landscapes can lead to another devastating wildfire. I'm urging all Washingtonians to not be that spark."

nary_nodes.label: NWS warns of extremely critical fire weather
evidence: The National Weather Service (NWS) had warned of "extremely critical" fire weather over the weekend
The National Weather Service (NWS) had warned of "extremely critical" fire weather over the weekend, with strong winds and unusually dry conditions helping the flames spread rapidly.

nary_nodes.label: Scientists say climate change increases wildfire risk
evidence: Scientists have said that human-induced climate change makes the warm, dry conditions that lead to wildfires more likely

Scientists have said that human-induced climate change makes the warm, dry conditions that lead to wildfires more likely - as well as leading to more frequent and intense heatwaves, and potential summer droughts.
